typedef complex<ld> pt;
typedef vector<pt> pol;
typedef vector<int> vi;

const char nl = '\n';
const ll INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
const ll INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;
const ld EPS = 1e-10;
mt19937_64 rng(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());

const int T = 99;
const int C = 12;

struct Edge {
    int dest, back;
    ll flow, capacity, weight;
};

Edge network[5000][5000];
int nodeDegree[5000];
ll totalExpense;

void clearNetwork(int size) {
    totalExpense = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        nodeDegree[i] = 0;
    }
}

void link(int from, int to, ll cap = 1, ll cost = 0) {
    totalExpense = max(totalExpense, cap);
    network[from][nodeDegree[from]++] = {to, nodeDegree[to], 0, cap, cost};
    network[to][nodeDegree[to]++] = {from, nodeDegree[from]-1, 0, 0, -cost};
}

bool marked[5000];
int predecessor[5000];
ll height[5000], shortest[5000];

void heightSetup(int n) {
    fill(height, height + n, 0);
    for (int iter = 1; iter < n; ++iter) {
        for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                Edge& e = network[u][i];
                if (e.capacity) {
                    height[e.dest] = min(height[e.dest], height[u] + e.weight);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ll relax(int source, int target, ll& totalCost, int nodeCount, bool useQueue) {
    fill(marked, marked + nodeCount, false);
    fill(shortest, shortest + nodeCount, INF);
    shortest[source] = 0;

    if (useQueue) {
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (marked[u]) continue;
            marked[u] = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                Edge& e = network[u][i];
                if (e.flow < e.capacity && shortest[e.dest] > shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight) {
                    shortest[e.dest] = shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight;
                    predecessor[e.dest] = i;
                    q.push(e.dest);
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int u = source; u != -1; ) {
            marked[u] = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeDegree[u]; ++i) {
                Edge& e = network[u][i];
                if (e.flow < e.capacity && shortest[e.dest] > shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight) {
                    shortest[e.dest] = shortest[u] + height[u] - height[e.dest] + e.weight;
                    predecessor[e.dest] = i;
                }
            }
            u = -1;
            ll best = INF;
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
                if (!marked[i] && shortest[i] < best) {
                    best = shortest[u = i];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (shortest[target] >= INF) return 0;

    ll bottleneck = INF;
    for (int node = target; node != source; ) {
        int idx = predecessor[node];
        Edge& rev = network[node][idx];
        bottleneck = min(bottleneck, network[rev.dest][rev.back].capacity - network[rev.dest][rev.back].flow);
        node = rev.dest;
    }

    for (int node = target; node != source; ) {
        int idx = predecessor[node];
        Edge& rev = network[node][idx];
        Edge& fwd = network[rev.dest][rev.back];
        fwd.flow += bottleneck;
        rev.flow -= bottleneck;
        totalCost += bottleneck * fwd.weight;
        node = rev.dest;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) {
        height[i] = min(INF, shortest[i] + height[i]);
    }
    return bottleneck;
}

ll minCostFlow(int source, int target, ll& totalCost, int nodeCount, bool useQueue) {
    heightSetup(nodeCount);
    ll totalFlow = 0;
    totalCost = 0;
    while (ll df = relax(source, target, totalCost, nodeCount, useQueue)) {
        totalFlow += df;
    }
    return totalFlow;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0);
    cout << fixed << setprecision(10);

    int n,m,k,c,d;
    cin>>n>>m>>k>>c>>d;

    const int source = 0;
    const int sink = n*T+1;

    clearNetwork(sink+1);

    for(int i=0;i<k;i++) {
        int a;
        cin>>a;
        link(source, a, 1, 0);
    }
    for(int t=0;t<T;t++) {
        link(1+t*n, sink, INF, 0);
        if(t>0) {
            for(int i=1;i<=n;i++) {
                link(i+(t-1)*n, i+t*n, INF, c);
            }
        }
    }

    for(int i=0;i<m;i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for(int j=0;j<C;j++) {
            int cost = (j+1)*(j+1) - j*j;
            for(int t=1;t<T;t++) {
                link(a+(t-1)*n, b+t*n, 1, cost*d + c);
                link(b+(t-1)*n, a+t*n, 1, cost*d + c);
            }
        }
    }

    ll price, flow = minCostFlow(source, sink, price, sink+1, true);
    assert(flow==k);
    cout << price << nl;

    return 0;
}
